title: Refactor TypeScript Kit to OOP Architecture with Kit Class
description: Refactor TypeScript Kit to OOP Architecture with Kit Class
summary: Refactored the TypeScript object graph further toward stateful classes: tightened plain/class conversion for local mutation snapshots, preserved wire ids while keeping runtime object pointers, made flatten and diff paths hydrate kit instances before operating, added guarded wire-id helpers for class/plain interop, made piece flatten kind resolution distinguish live Type pointers from serialized ids, and updated sketchpad TypeScript boundary for the ongoing transition. Verification was intentionally skipped after the latest instruction to not test or build for now.
